# DSH Plugins

> A bilingual directory of popular DeepSeek Harness plugins, DSH skills, MCP tools, model adapters, productivity workflows, DevOps runtimes and themes.

- Website: https://dsh-plugin.top/
- Sitemap: https://dsh-plugin.top/sitemap.xml
- GitHub topic source: https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin
- Catalog size: 5307

## Categories

- 技能 (skills): 3099
- 工具 (tools): 447
- 模型适配 (model-adapters): 341
- 企业 (enterprise): 240
- 生产力 (productivity): 735
- DevOps (devops): 133
- 主题 (themes): 312

## Popular plugins

- [Agent reverse engineering tool](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/morluto/rea/): Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries. (425682 GitHub stars)
- [DeepSeek Harness Agent Framework](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/): An open-source agent framework from DeepSeek AI that combines models, tools and interfaces through plugins. (270739 GitHub stars)
- [Open-Source Design Workbench](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/nexu-io/open-design/): An open-source, local design workspace that turns coding agents into tools for creating prototypes, presentations, images and video. (105672 GitHub stars)
- [Architecture Visualization Skill](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/tt-a1i/archify/): A Skill that turns repositories or system descriptions into interactive technical diagrams for architecture reviews and explanations. (93040 GitHub stars)
- [All you do is install this plugin in dsh](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model/): All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. (58659 GitHub stars)
- [Nuwa Skill](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/alchaincyf/nuwa-skill/): A Nuwa Skill project for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. (37334 GitHub stars)
- [Draw and edit draw](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io/): Draw and edit draw.io diagrams by chatting with an AI. Web app, desktop app, and an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and VS Code. (36637 GitHub stars)
- [WeKnora](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Tencent/WeKnora/): An open-source knowledge framework that combines document understanding, RAG retrieval, agent reasoning and generated wikis. (36371 GitHub stars)
- [DeepSeek-for your terminal](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/): An AI coding agent for the terminal, with configurable models, tools and plugins plus desktop and editor integrations. (36053 GitHub stars)
- [anywhere-lab · DSH desktop client](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/): A desktop client for DeepSeek Harness that combines the local agent service, native windows and a plugin marketplace. (34696 GitHub stars)
- [Image upload engine](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Molunerfinn/PicGo/): A desktop image uploader that creates ready-to-paste links for articles, documentation and publishing workflows. (27457 GitHub stars)
- [Distilly](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/titanwings/distilly/): Turn chats, documents and interviews into reusable profiles and Skills that capture a person's communication style and working methods. (26334 GitHub stars)
- [Personality Distillation AI Skill](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/titanwings/colleague-skill/): Create a reusable AI Skill from a person's thinking patterns, communication habits and professional experience. (23108 GitHub stars)
- [Wire harness engineering tutorial for beginners, from 0 to 1](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/walkinglabs/learn-harness-engineering/): Harness engineering beginner tutorial, from 0 to 1. (23044 GitHub stars)
- [DeepSeek Harness Plugin Directory](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/): A continuously maintained directory of noteworthy plugins across the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. (22200 GitHub stars)
- [Cross-Platform AI Web Enhancement Suite](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Nagi-ovo/voyager/): A browser extension that helps organize AI chats, reuse prompts and navigate long conversations more comfortably. (19997 GitHub stars)
- [DeepSeek Harness Desktop](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop/): A modern desktop experience built for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ecosystem (18946 GitHub stars)
- [DSHDesktop](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/dataelement/dsh-desktop/): A DSH Desktop project for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. (17179 GitHub stars)
- [DSH Purge](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/): Version 1.3.5 DeepSeek Harness Armor breaking: All models can break armor, and different prompt words can be changed for different models. (16890 GitHub stars)
- [Each AI agent has a portable memory layer](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/EverMind-AI/EverOS/): One portable memory layer for every AI agent: local-first, Markdown-native, user-owned, and self-evolving across apps, tools, and workflows. (13799 GitHub stars)
- [A self-evolving memory operating system for LLM and AI agents](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/MemTensor/MemOS/): Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support. (12240 GitHub stars)
- [DSH plug-in market](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/dsh-market/dsh-market/): The plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness. (10482 GitHub stars)
- [DSH Web Plugin Bundle](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/): A plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness Web that brings task management, mobile access, SSH operations and image understanding into one workspace. (10009 GitHub stars)
- [BrowserSkill](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Tencent/BrowserSkill/): Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. (9965 GitHub stars)
- [Skill](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/anbeime/skill/): Skills Store - Skill Store contains the most complete and fastest-updated AI Agent skills library, covering selected skill packages in multiple fields such as document processing, content creation, programming develop. (9096 GitHub stars)
- [Multi-Device Agent Workspace](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/YaoApp/yao/): Manage agents, workspaces, and task boards across desktop, mobile, browser, and API clients. (8260 GitHub stars)
- [Honcho](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/plastic-labs/honcho/): Memory library for building stateful agents. (7912 GitHub stars)
- [Webnovel Writer](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/lingfengQAQ/webnovel-writer/): A Webnovel Writer project for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. (7818 GitHub stars)
- [Self-Evolving AI Workbench](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/Devin-AXIS/iPolloWork/): A local-first visual AI workbench that turns one goal into editable code, documents, presentations, websites, designs, and videos. (7368 GitHub stars)
- [OpenRouter for proxy tools](https://dsh-plugin.top/en/plugin/superdesigndev/treg/): (OpenRouter for Tools) OpenRouter, but for agent tools instead of models. (7086 GitHub stars)
